section_summary: This section comprises Department of State correspondence, military permits, travel applications, and diplomatic notes concerning entry into and departure from occupied Japan between August and November 1949. Major subjects include private trade applications and SCAP theater clearances for commercial representatives, travel arrangements for religious missionaries, and exit authorization procedures. Significant diplomatic cases include Brazilian efforts to repatriate Hilde Wiebke from Dairen via Japan, Bolivian representations for the return of technical expert Tomas Tamiichi Komori, and consular inquiries regarding transshipment through Japanese ports.
